description: Claim up to max messages from a queue, each with a lease. Finish with queue_ack, or queue_nack to retry later. A lease that runs out hands the message to the next claim (at least once: make your work idempotent).

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your app has no sign-in and cannot send it as an Authorization header.

queue.description: Queue name: 1 to 64 characters from a-z 0-9 . _ -.

name: queue_claim
title: Claim messages from my queue
